physicalNotes: Radius 2.83 +/- 0.01 Jupiter radii and temperature 1935 +/- 12 K: the joint low- and high-resolution retrieval with grey clouds that Inglis et al. (2024, AJ; doi:10.3847/1538-3881/ad2771; arXiv:2402.09533, Table 3) prefer: 202,322.4 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. A model radius: the planet is unresolved. Xuan et al. (2024) give 2.1 +/- 0.35 from evolutionary models. GM from the evolutionary-model mass 13 +/- 5 Jupiter masses of Xuan et al. (2024, arXiv:2405.13128, Table 1) times Jupiter's GM; Kraus et al. (2014) give 10 +/- 4. The orbit places the planet around A, while it was fitted about the pair's centre of mass, which lies at most about 5 au from A. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
